name: dual-review
description: /dual-review: two fresh read-only reviewers (plus a dedicated security reviewer on risky changes) review the current change in parallel and re-review one numbered fix list until both agree. Depth follows the change's risk; findings carry every instance of a bug class; pre-existing bugs are listed apart; REVIEW.md is followed when present. --fix applies agreed fixes and has fresh reviewers verify them. Claude Code only.
